answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation with graduated trust. Each agent identity posts a small refundable bond and starts on a narrow ledge: it may handle only low-value tasks, and false attestations slash its bond. As it completes verified work, its standing grows, like a walnut gaining a hard shell around a kernel of proven behavior, and its public record earns a violet verified mark. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real bonds and months of slow work, while honest agents keep their stake and keep rising.
